content: An ultraintelligent machine could design ever-better machines, yielding an intelligence explosion.
STaR bootstraps a model's own generated rationales to improve reasoning without new labels.
Reflexion converts environment feedback into verbal self-reflection stored in an episodic memory.
Self-Refine improves outputs by iterating generate/self-critique/refine with the same model.
Process supervision that verifies each reasoning step outperforms outcome-only reward on hard math.
An automated pipeline generates ideas, runs experiments, and writes papers with a reviewer in the loop.
Verifier-driven selection raises solution accuracy relative to unverified self-improvement.
Self-reflection gains are bounded by the fidelity of the feedback signal available to the agent.
